inlines.text: 今日，Anthropic, PBC 就其拟进行的 A 类普通股首次公开募股，向美国证券交易委员会提交了 S-1 表格注册声明。

blocks.text: Anthropic 拟将其 A 类普通股在纳斯达克全球精选市场上市，股票代码为“ANT”。拟发行的 A 类普通股股数及拟发行价格区间尚未确定。

blocks.text: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

inlines.text: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

blocks.text: Anthropic intends to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.” The number of shares of Class A common stock to be offered and the price range for the proposed offering have not yet been determined.
